messages:
acme-integration: hitting a production customer bug — our downstream JSON parser keeps choking with a 400 from the Redwood /generate endpoint. example error: "invalid JSON: unexpected NUL at position 482"
elsa: thanks for filing, can you paste the raw request body you sent (or obfuscated keys)? any chance there are binary blobs in strings?
acme-integration: sending a structured JSON payload in \`json_mode\`. we reproduce reliably with our Windows CI job that posts files. here's the trimmed payload (we replaced secrets):
```
{
  "user_id": "acct-123",
  "note": "Import from CSV�",
  "items": ["a", "b"]
}
```
elsa: aha — payload contains a literal NUL (�) inside a string. our JSON mode expects valid UTF-8 text; some downstream parsers (and our streaming parser) treat a NUL as a protocol-breaking char.
samir: repro steps request — acme says the CI job uses PowerShell and `Get-Content -Raw` then `Invoke-RestMethod -Body` which can embed NULs if the source file is treated as binary. can you share the exact curl/ps command?
acme-integration: reproduce command (Windows agent):
```powershell
$body = Get-Content input.json -Raw
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -Method Post -Body $body -Headers @{Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_TOKEN"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json'}
```
acme-integration: switching to `-Encoding UTF8` still leaves the hidden null in our fixture. we only see it when files were created by an old exporter (C lib) that pads strings.
maya: infra note — our HTTP server reads bytes and hands a buffer to the JSON-mode streamer; the streamer uses a C parser that rejects embedded NULs as invalid string data. it should return a 400 with clearer message but currently surfaces a lower-level parser error.
elsa: immediate workaround for customer: strip NULs before send or base64-encode fields that may contain binary. also `Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8` + `.TrimEnd("\0")` on PowerShell side should fix.
samir: long term: we can 1) improve error message to call out "embedded NUL/� in string" 2) add an optional lenient-json flag on structured mode to accept and normalize control chars (dangerous) 3) add a server-side sanitizer option behind a feature flag for enterprise customers.
elsa: customer asks about billing — they retried 8 times and worried about charges. support: we'll mark these as system-side malformed request retries and issue credits. tagging billing team. :money_with_wings:
deploy-bot: incident created: INC-2981 — json-mode-nullbyte-parsing, priority P2.
maya: assigning to samir to triage parser UX; I'll follow on infra changes if we need sanitizer hook.
samir: I'll try to reproduce in a container with a fixture that contains embedded � and add a unit test. posting my first repro log in a sec.
elsa: thanks — please include minimal fix suggestion so we can share a customer-safe timeline.
acme-integration: thx team, workaround implemented (strip NULs), verifying in prod. will update if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
